triage.fix_sketch: In shared_web/static/css/pd.css:2855 change `minmax(11rem, 1fr)` to `minmax(9rem, 1fr)`. At 9rem (144px), two tiles + gap = 294.75px which comfortably fits in 358px. No template or Python changes needed.
